title: Line sketch: Castle at Sunset
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A dramatic medieval cityscape with towering stone buildings and spires reflected in a calm river during a fiery sunset. The glowing sun dominates the sky while warm light illuminates windows and creates shimmering reflections on the water (derived from painting #920).
